Resolves #19501

Blog posts now get routes. `collectBlogRoutes` turns each `blog.json` leaf into `/news/blog/<id>`, the route the portal answers (`TabContainerController`: `/news/blog/{*itemId}`). Each post is dated by its markdown file, and a post whose file is missing fails by name. Blog routes enter the sitemap at priority 0.9, replacing nine hard-coded `blog/*` ids that no collector could emit, and `llms.txt` gains a Blog section.

Evidence: L2 achieved. The unit spec runs, and the real generator CLI on this head emits 15 of 15 posts, each with a `lastmod`. L3 is required for AC-5: the deployed site has to serve the new routes. Residual: AC-5, Residual-Owner: #9849, whose AC-3 is "SSG+ route verified on neomjs.com".

Intake: self-authored this session (the carve). Prescription checked: `buildScripts/docs/seo/generate.mjs` owns the concern, being the one route list the sitemap, `llms.txt` and the site's route objects share. The portal's blog index stays the single source of the posts. Class: restoration (`fix`), since the generator's own priority table expected blog routes it never produced. agent-preflight: not hosted here; the baseline jobs ran.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `Generate.spec.mjs`, *every post in the portal blog index gets a route, a sitemap entry and an llms.txt line*: each `blog.json` leaf appears as `<loc>https://neomjs.com/news/blog/<id></loc>` at priority 0.9. The CLI scratch run gives 15 of 15 locs with `lastmod`, e.g. `the-salute` at 2026-09-15. |
| AC-2 | The same spec checks every post's `llms.txt` line, `- [<name>](https://neomjs.com/raw/<path>)`. In the CLI run, the `## Blog` section lists all 15. |
| AC-3 | The nine `['blog/…', 0.9]` entries are gone, and a grep for `['blog/` in the generator returns 0. `getPriority` gives `/news/blog/` routes 0.9. |
| AC-4 | Two unit tests cover `collectBlogRoutes`: a post becomes `/news/blog/blog/a-post` dated by its file, and a missing file fails naming `blog/missing-post`. |
| AC-5 | Post-merge, after the site's next pipeline run (Post-Merge Validation). |

## Deltas from ticket

None substantive. The emitted id form `/news/blog/<blog.json id>` (for example `/news/blog/blog/the-salute`) mirrors the portal's hash route and the release pattern (`/news/releases/<v>`, which the site serves today).

## Test Evidence

- **Mutation.** With `...blogRoutes` removed from `collectAllRoutes`, exactly the integration test fails (1 failed, 15 passed). Restored, 16 of 16 pass.
- **The real CLI** (`generate.mjs --format xml|llms` into a scratch path, with an empty corpus root) produces 15 blog locs, matching the 15 leaves.
- **Guards:** `check-ticket-archaeology` 0 violations, `check-file-sizes` 0 violations, and every pre-commit check green.

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] After the data-sync pipeline regenerates `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` and the site redeploys, `https://neomjs.com/news/blog/blog/the-salute` answers 200 with the post.
